note: PRIOR SEED — safe day-1 weights. The head here simply follows the economic graph (graph_prior) and ABSA; it is NOT trained yet. With NEWS_HEAD_ENABLED=true it behaves ~like the graph+ABSA merge and then improves automatically as the news-nlp service retrains on the forward-collected tape (writes head_weights to Neon, loaded at runtime by head.ts). GDELT/FNSPID are an optional cold-start accelerator, not a prerequisite.
